comments.author: @UKnowIfUKnow
comments.text:
Lack of Depth Precision, cameras struggle with accurate depth perception, especially at long distances or at low-contrast whereas LIDAR/radar  handle this much better
Rain, snow, darkness, sun glare, and dirty lenses all degrade a camera's ability to discern details. People can generally infer what they can't see. The onboard NI is not up to that task with vision only.
 Cameras often need multiple frames and NI cycles to track and predict motion. LIDAR and radar offer more direct velocity and range measurements.
IMHO, Robotaxis will ultimately adopt additional sensors, be permanently geofenced or fail.
